result.title: Improving the Expressive Power of Hybrid Sequence Models via Multi-Hop Retrieval
result.summary: Hybrid architectures offer a promising approach to efficient language modeling by combining a small number of full-attention layers with a larger number of efficient sequence layers, such as sparse attention and recurrent layers. While full-attention layers maintain a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, efficient layers typically rely on separate, fixed-size states rather than accessing this richer existing memory. Recent work has begun exploring ways to allow efficient layers access to the KV cache, but the theoretical benefits of such access, and the extent to which existing approaches can realize them remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions by analyzing the expressive power of individual hybrid blocks on function composition, a well-studied task in sequence-model expressivity associated with multi-hop reasoning. We first establish that both conventional hybrid blocks and those with top-$κ$ KV-cache access require $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ capacity to compute even two-function composition over a domain of size $n$. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the \emph{Multi-hop Retrieval Attention} (MuRA) hybrid block, a simple architecture that enables multi-hop retrieval from a shared KV cache while preserving asymptotic computational and memory efficiency. We prove that a single fixed size $m$-hop MuRA block can compute $m$-function composition, whereas computing $(m+1)$-function composition with the same retrieval depth requires polynomial model size, establishing a strict expressivity hierarchy in retrieval depth. Synthetic experiments support this hierarchy, showing that increasing retrieval depth enables learning progressively deeper compositions, substantially outperforming existing hybrid architectures. Together, our results identify multi-hop retrieval as a promising mechanism for improving the expressive power of efficient hybrid architectures.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从表达能力角度分析混合序列模型：证明常规混合块与 top-κ KV 缓存访问计算两函数复合需 Ω(√n) 容量，并提出 MuRA 混合块，通过共享 KV 缓存上的多跳检索以固定规模实现 m 函数复合，形成随检索深度递增的严格表达能力层级，并用合成实验验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 多跳检索共享 KV 缓存、按检索深度划分表达能力层级的设计，可能为 LVR 中潜在状态如何跨跳获取视觉证据、以及视觉信息坍缩与检索深度取舍提供可核查的方法线索；属纯文本架构理论，迁移到多模态尚待验证。
